obligations.obligation: blocked action remains explained and navigable
obligations.evidence: The 'Confirm root cause' button is aria-disabled ('ariaDisabled: true') and its operability probe (controlIndex 9) shows outcome 'not-clickable: locator.click: Timeout 2000ms exceeded', confirming it is truly unavailable, consistent with capabilities['confirm-root-cause']='illegal'. Its describedByText explains the reason and lists 5 linked blocking conditions. Probes 10-14 (controlIndex 10-14) each click one of these links and confirm focus actually lands on the named predicate's list item (e.g. probe-010: focused text 'UNKNOWN Blocking unknown exists ... Not established. May block actions that depend on it.'), demonstrating real navigation, not just a claim.

responsive.notes: Same button, same describedByText, and same anchor links present in all viewports' aria trees; probes are desktop-only evidence of operability per instructions, and the same controls are assumed to exist elsewhere given identical aria trees.

evidenceLimitations: The four viewport aria.txt files are byte-identical, so the only viewport-specific evidence available is document height/layout from the full-page screenshots; no independent per-viewport accessibility-tree check was possible beyond confirming they match desktop. Operability probes were only executed once (implicitly at the viewport used to record them, presumably desktop), so cross-viewport operability is inferred from the identical aria trees per the instructions rather than directly observed at each viewport.
